author: CNN
description:
White House border czar Tom Homan just addressed the press in Minneapolis after being sent to take the reins on the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown in Minnesota. Homan says he will be “staying ‘til the problem’s gone,” and he has ordered federal immigration authorities to work on a “drawdown plan” for law enforcement in the state.

0:00 Trump’s border czar speaks about a “drawdown” of federal agents in Minneapolis 
1:09 CNN correspondent on takeaways from Tom Homan’s press conference 
4:27 Democratic House rep. reacts to border czar’s remarks 
6:46 Republican senator on the investigation into Minneapolis ICE shootings 

#Minneapolis #TomHoman  #News
title: 'Drawdown' of MN immigration agents in the works: Trump border czar

author: CNN
description: President Trump’s border czar Tom Homan said he has ordered federal immigration authorities to work on an eventual draw-down plan for federal agents in Minnesota. Homan, who is taking control of Trump’s immigration crackdown in Minnesota, said operations on the ground will be targeted. This comes after Renee Good and Alex Pretti were shot and killed by federal agents. #cnn #news
title: Homan says ICE & CBP are working on Minneapolis ‘draw-down plan’

title: Woman whose husband went missing in ICE custody speaks to CNN

description:

They also discuss Millennial activism taking over the generation’s Instagram feed as ICE protests continue in Minneapolis.

description:
Amid tensions following the two fatal shootings of U.S. citizens in Minneapolis by federal immigration officials and weeks-long protests, officials and community leaders including Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey, Minneapolis Police Chief Brian O’Hara, Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison, Minnesota State Rep. Nolan West (R), Minnesota State Sen. Michael Holmstrom (R) and Minnesota State Rep. Elliott Engen (R) will take questions and discuss possible pathways forward with local community members and impacted Minnesotans.

The live audience will be comprised of Minnesotans from across the political spectrum.
